description: This Java source file defines the DataFile class for the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages reading, writing, and parsing data files based on models and definitions, including handling records, streams, and external references.

classes.name: DataFile
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing data files, including parsing, serialization, and record management in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads and creates a DataFile object from specified file URL and definition URL with a data file name.

methods.name: makeDataFile
methods.description: Constructs a DataFile object based on the data file definition obtained from the definition URL.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Returns the list of records contained in this DataFile.

methods.name: addRecord
methods.description: Adds a new Record to the DataFile.

methods.name: makeRecord
methods.description: Creates a new Record instance based on the specified model record name.

methods.name: writeDataFile
methods.description: Writes all records to a specified filename.
